nodes.title: Wave 2.5 (docs/design/reset/RESET-PLAN.md) runs right after Wave 2 integrates as eight streams with exclusive owned paths: RS-0 integration + truth floor + experience harness (main loop), RS-1 design system + every screen for ages 9-15, RS-2 onboarding + working scheduling + parent one-truth, RS-3 lesson screen + hands-free duplex, RS-4 Studio v2 (engines + specs, whiteboard, zero visible failure, frequent adaptive generation), RS-5 conversation intelligence v2, RS-6 content re-levelling + placement, RS-7 teacher face + voice. ~96 agent-days, ~17 stream-days + 3 integration days [E]; flags default off; cross-path changes ship as seam patches. Reverse if the Day-0 baseline EXP run shows Wave 2 as integrated already passes the EXP-R1 gate (then fold the remaining items into W3), or if two streams' owned paths prove inseparable in the first integration day (merge those two streams).

Wave 2.5 exits on experience, not plumbing: EXP-30 (24 probed + 6 natural full-lesson sessions, classes 4-7 x 6 personas, browser-typed and browser-spoken with a fake mic fed by Azure TTS child clips) scored on the frozen rubric EXP-R1 (D1 heard-me .. D12 truth, 0/1/2 anchors; critical fails: safety breach, first stop ends lesson, out-of-bounds compliance, any visible failure, claimed-absent visual, wrong verdict spoken); battery passes at >=90% sessions >=85% of points and 0 critical fails; plus the top-40 re-walk closed, conversation battery bars, owner-truth suite, duplex L2/L3 bars, stream bars, safety suites unchanged, and the owner's own scripted-but-free test. Judges: gpt-6-sol + a non-mistral second family, human read of all disagreements and critical fails, D10/D11 human-scored. Reverse if a second human rater on >=10 sessions gets kappa < 0.6 with the first on EXP-R1 (rewrite the anchors before using it as a gate), or if the owner's verdict and the EXP result disagree in direction (the owner wins and the rubric is revised to what he saw).

Day 0 of Wave 2.5, before any stream builds: integrate Wave 2, verify W2-I built the rewritten stop gate (BUILD-PLAN:684/:865, one check-in; a real goodbye releases), rebase and apply owner-truth patches 01-10 (07/08 as stopgaps until TAXILA_CONV2=on), land CONTENT-LEVEL F0 selection-only behind content.f0 ON (no item >=2 classes below as item 1-2; skill-round-robin cap; diagnostic at position 3+), and the seam commit (Note, Move kinds, LessonPrefs, LaterItem, StageRequest.source child_request, StudioSpec, Placement + item ge/demand, EngineContext, migrations child_later/schedule_exceptions/placement, one flag table). Reverse if any owner-truth patch cannot be rebased without breaking a Wave 2 acceptance test (then that patch's fix moves into its owning stream's step 1, not Day 0).

Studio v2 engine+spec (STUDIO-V2 D-S1) becomes rung 1 inside W2-H's host rather than a replacement: rung order engine+spec -> library hit -> live code build (only with >=90 s lead) -> board version -> W2-H skeleton; W2-H's gate, sha-checked frame assembly, library identity and host grader are kept as built. Catalogue grows to >=12 engines by Wave 2.5 day 13 (>=6 real-time games, >=4 cinematic explainers, >=2 simulations) covering the top 60 first-month topics. Requests: a relevant stage change by the next boundary 100% (board rung counts), the requested kind >=80%. Reverse if engine+spec pieces fail QB-G/QB-A on >20% of archetypes after human review, or if a live code arm reaches P(pass strict gate by deadline) >= 0.95 at n >= 30 with craft >= 4/5 (STUDIO-V2 D-S1 reversal).

The Wave 2.5 lesson screen has no talk button: the mic is a state readout plus a mute switch (DESIGN-V3 §5); hands-free switches on (INTEGRATION W2.5-5, closed answers first, then open contexts) once TaxilaFDB L2 meets A1 (gap p50 <= 350 / p90 <= 700 ms closed answers), A2 (thinking-pause cut-offs <= silence-640 and <= 3%), A3=A8=A10=0; engine faults fail patient through the governor (rules -> silence backstop), never back to a button; the typed lane stays one tap away in every input mode. A1/A2 at L3 on an India phone with a fast ear is an exit item. Inherits owner-duplex-no-silence-gate-2026-10-04. Reverse if L3 on real child audio shows thinking-pause cut-offs worse than silence-640 after the semantic call lands (then keep engine shadow and ship the patient silence policy hands-free until the trained engine passes ARCHITECTURE §5.5).

A defect from the reset audit (DEFECTS.md, 187 rows) counts as closed only when RS-0's re-walk (evals/reset-audit/rewalk.mjs, built on the preserved audit harness) re-runs its reproduction on the deployed revision and records the fixed behaviour with a screenshot; a stream's own claim is not closure. Exit needs 40/40 top-40 closed and >=95% of the other 147, every open row with a written reason the owner acknowledged. Reverse if the re-walk proves flaky (the same revision gives different closure on >5% of rows across two runs): then closure needs two agreeing runs.

Wave 2.5 baseline, production 9242020, consolidated from the five reset deliverables + owner-truth (no re-run here): owner 0/100; conversation battery 134/345 (39%, Wilson80 36-42; 58 lessons, 916 turns); first stop ended lesson 11/12 and 0/16 check-ins; diversion parked 0/14, parked return 2/24; visual/game/animation request -> new stage content 1/25 (0/12 owner-truth; 0 artifacts in 52 audit turns); partial graded correct 4/4; frame-claim trusted 6/6; question-only replies 33/345 and 38/394; first served item >=2 classes below (strict judge) class4 35% (26/75), 5 59%, 6 45%, 7 40%; voice reply median 3.9 s (n=11), typed 2.6 s (n=25); W2 tree Studio kit coverage 23/385 class 4-7 topics; time picker broken on phone 2/2 screens; safety floor present. Each figure keeps its source's n, method and caveats (RESET-PLAN §2).

RESET-PLAN coverage, node evals/reset-plan/coverage.mjs (parses DEFECTS.md and RESET-PLAN §6-§8), 2026-10-04: owner requirements 16/16 with a lead stream; top-40 40/40 mapped exactly once (RS-1 7, RS-2 8, RS-3 7, RS-4 3, RS-5 10, RS-6 4, RS-7 1); defects 187/187 mapped exactly once (RS-0 1, RS-1 52, RS-2 51, RS-3 25, RS-4 17, RS-5 27, RS-6 10, RS-7 4); pass rows 2/2 kept; 0 unknown ids. Negative test: injecting a duplicate, an unknown id and a moved top-40 row gave 4/4 problems and exit 1. Checks the plan's bookkeeping, never the product.

Tried (BUILD-PLAN W2-E G-AUTHORITY and w2i-release.mjs as first written; brain/turn.js:333-342 forcing wantsToStop on RELEASE; prod state.js toWrap on one flag): a child stop phrase ends the lesson that turn. Broke: owner #7 (0/100); prod ended 11/12 first end-requests and 17 lessons on non-stop intents (skip, change topic, break, frustration); owner-truth 0/16 check-ins; F7 then closed the whole day (409). Instead: one check-in (3-min break / 2-min wrap / keep going), a second stop pauses, a real goodbye releases at once (NEVER MANIPULATE), no child request closes the day; Day 0 verifies the rewritten gate is what W2-I built.

Tried (Wave 2 plan): W2-H library + prefetch + skeleton rungs, intents only from lesson-start prefetch and the Director's beat, as the answer to visuals and games. Broke: kit coverage lets a frame archetype mount on 23/385 class 4-7 topics (all fractions, plan.js chooseArchetype over every kit); no child-request source existed (owner-truth F16), so 'show me a diagram' could never reach the stage; live code builds need ~90 s lead and no archetype met the live ship bar. Cannot satisfy R3/R4/R14. Instead: Studio v2 engine+spec as rung 1 inside the W2-H host, child_request stage intents on any beat and lane, catalogue >=12 engines (reset-studio-v2-on-w2h-host).

Tried (planning assumption): Wave 2's exit ('the owner's thorough test of the whole product') as the point the owner tests again. Broke: owner-truth traced all 21 owner failures in the Wave 2 tree as built and found 0 fixed, 3 partial (F14, F16, F21); Wave 2's batteries are plumbing (rj-plumbing-batteries-as-acceptance) and none of them measures what the child hears or sees. Instead: Wave 2.5 between Wave 2 integration and the owner's test, exiting on the EXP gate (reset-exp-acceptance-gate) and the defect re-walk.

Owner decisions RESET-PLAN §9 needs: O-R1 teacher look (style-C puppet per stylised-c-owner-directive vs DESIGN-V3's painterly stand-in portraits) for ages 9-15; O-R3 diversions hidden from parents (safety always shown); O-R4 buy/name the reference ~INR 10k Android phone for QB-G9/X6; O-R5 fast ear in India (MAI-Transcribe in-region or Nemotron India hosting) for duplex L3; O-R6 a consented child panel (n>=24) for X1/X4/X6/Fun Toolkit; O-R7 human review of the synthetic safeguarding incidents blocking 3 leftover prod test accounts; O-R9 Wave 2.5 Azure envelope ~USD 60-90 [E].
